summary: Overland Advantage filed an 8-K/A to correct a typographical error on the cover page of its original 8-K, changing the date of report from October 30, 2025, to July 2, 2026. The filing also describes an amendment to its revolving credit facility, extending the revolving period to July 2028 and maturity to July 2030, and reducing the interest rate spread and unused fee. These are routine financing amendments, not a special situation event. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, or other special-situation trigger. The filing provides no deal terms relevant to corporate event classification.
